coverage: All Census 2025 places in the 50 states, DC and Puerto Rico, plus functioning minor civil division governments in town/township states. Incorporated cities, towns, boroughs and villages and active towns/townships are included by default. Statistical and nonfunctioning county divisions are excluded; duplicate legal entities and consolidated town/city governments are represented once. Full consolidated-city boundaries are included. Statistical city balances and CDPs are separately labeled and opt-in. Whole governments are retained across county lines. Nested municipalities and townships retain their own legal boundaries. Cartographic boundaries are generalized, not survey or parcel boundaries.
